whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Lounge Before Wicket,

I noticed your lounge has incredible 4.1★ reviews with over 1,300 happy patrons in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table bookings and event inquiries.

Maine aapke lounge ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, food menu showcase, aur special event inquiries integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/lbw

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Lounge Before Wicket, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke lounge ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, mobile-first speed, and a vibrant showcase of your venue in Ghrounda, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual venue photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
